historical_record.description: The apartment building, six residential floors over two parking levels with 13 stalls, originally 34 rental units, was built in 1925.

After tenants, many of them elderly and long resident, objected, the City Planning Commission unanimously refused the conversion of the apartment building into 27 condominiums as inconsistent with the Master Plan (Resolution 7823).

By 1 December 1977, the Board of Supervisors had reversed the City Planning Commission's refusal of the condominium conversion of the apartment building, imposing the Department's recommended conditions but no maximum sale prices.
